verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a serverless platform, but the evidence never documents a way to keep Worker-to-Worker or service-to-service traffic off the public internet. Bindings are described only as a way to connect to external services. Sandbox egress control, built-in Zero Trust and agent RPC are adjacent features, not private service networking.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can keep internal service-to-service traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity
